title: A Ember for the Sigil
author: Sebastian Montrose
blurb: Wren Underhill, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
